name: Balkrishna Industries Ltd
title: Balkrishna Industries Ltd-$ - 502355 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record Q4 OHT volumes (85,820 MT, +5% YoY) and FY26 highest-ever, but management stopped volume guidance, RM costs set to rise 7-8% in Q1 FY27, and capex raised to INR6,800 crore through FY29.

capex.quote: The Board of Directors has approved an additional capex of INR2,000 crores

triggers.label: Volume guidance withdrawn
triggers.quote: we stopped giving guidance due to the geopolitical scenarios and uncertainties

triggers.label: Capex raised to INR6,800 cr to FY29
triggers.quote: you are talking about overall capex till FY '29 of INR6,800 crores

triggers.label: RM cost up 7-8% in June quarter
triggers.quote: This quarter, approximately, it may go up around 7% to 8% more.

triggers.label: Channel inventory at normal levels
triggers.quote: No, we see it at normal levels.

triggers.label: Price hikes 3-5% taken so far
triggers.quote: So price hike, we have taken between 3% to 5% already across various geographies

guidance.quote: In this financial year, between INR1,500 crores to INR1,800 crores.
maintenance is about INR200-odd crores every year, which will be extra
we are, as a company, looking to keep sustained EBITDA levels
That is our ambition, and that is what we are targeting for the year.

red_flags.label: Volume guidance withdrawn; RM inflation 7-8% and margin pressure flagged
red_flags.quote: At this moment, we may have some price pressures, margin pressures.

red_flags.label: Management repeatedly declined to quantify on-highway pricing and margins
red_flags.quote: Our price positioning is at par with the market leaders.
